not guarantee independence in failure causes. Small operators optimizing independently under identical market pressures will converge on identical technology stacks (e.g., the same cloud provider, the same CDN, the same TLS library). This creates a hidden shared dependency: a vulnerability in that common layer triggers simultaneous, catastrophic failures across the 'decentralized' network. Because the convergence is emergent rather than planned, the correlation is invisible until the triggering event, making the system strictly harder to reason about than a monolith which at least knows it relies on a single stack.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
